sections.title: Home Page Redesign
items: Replaced the HeroUI table with a card-based pack layout — each card gets its own row with collection badge, name, and number
Per-card completion checkboxes let staff check off cards as they pull them from the binder — progress counter shows X/10 completed
Pack automatically resets checkmarks when a new pack is generated
Improved header layout with action buttons stacked on mobile and side-by-side on desktop
Error state now shows an inline retry button instead of a silent failure

sections.title: Brand & Design
items: Updated M3 color tokens to Oakland Zoo navy (#102f54) — replaces the default Material purple across all surfaces, buttons, and focus rings in both light and dark themes
Version 3 announcement banner on the home page with a link to the changelog — dismissable and remembers your choice
Collection badges now use M3 typography (text-label-medium) for consistency with the rest of the design system

sections.title: Feedback
items: New Submit Feedback button in the navbar (desktop) and mobile menu — opens a dialog without interrupting your workflow
Feedback form supports four types: General Feedback, Bug Report, Feature Request, and Other
Optional reply-to email field so you can receive a direct response
Submissions are delivered by email via Resend with a formatted HTML receipt

sections.title: Accessibility
items: Entrance animations now respect the prefers-reduced-motion system setting via useReducedMotion

sections.title: Admin Tutorial
items: First-run admin tutorial with a 10-step spotlight tour covering all four admin pages — SVG mask overlay highlights the active element while dimming the rest
Step cards float next to the highlighted target on desktop and slide up as a bottom sheet on mobile
Keyboard navigable (Escape, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight) and persisted in localStorage so it only shows once
A '?' help button in the top app bar lets admins replay the tutorial at any time

sections.title: M3Button Migration
items: New M3Button component with Material Design 3 shape morphing (pill → rect press) and DOM-direct ripple — no React re-render during gesture
Replaced all 43 instances of @heroui/button across 15 files — HeroUI Button is no longer used anywhere in the codebase
Spinner automatically renders inside the button when isLoading is true

sections.title: Category Management
items: Category admin panel with optimistic UI updates for wildcard eligibility toggles
Centralized normalizeCategoryId utility prevents ID drift between creation and Firestore writes
GA4 events now fire after Firestore awaits to prevent phantom success records

sections.title: Typography
items: All admin UI migrated from raw Tailwind type classes (text-xs, text-sm, font-semibold) to M3 named utilities (text-label-large, text-body-medium, etc.) — enforced as a project standard going forward

sections.title: Admin Dashboard
items: New admin layout shell with M3 Top App Bar and collapsible Navigation Drawer — auth-gated via Clerk, separate from the public DefaultLayout
Card management page with full CRUD — add, edit, and delete cards; inline search, filter by collection, and column sorting
User management page with invite-by-email and role visibility; powered by a Vercel serverless API layer that proxies Clerk's backend SDK
Custom Clerk account panel replaces the hosted Clerk iframe for consistent M3 styling
Analytics dashboard with native SVG line and bar charts — no chart library dependency; data sourced from GA4 via a serverless proxy using a service-account credential

sections.title: Changelog
items: Changelog page redesigned with M3 card layout, recency badges (New / Recent), and a show-all toggle that collapses older entries by default

sections.title: Analytics
items: Migrated analytics to GA4 Data API with a serverless proxy — admin dashboard can now surface real usage metrics
GA4 event hardening: exception() calls now include fatal: false for non-critical errors; timing events consolidated to one per batch instead of one per pack

sections.title: Design System
items: Formalized M3 motion system — standard, emphasized, and accelerate/decelerate easing curves; short/medium/long duration scale added to Tailwind config
M3 typography scale finalized and applied across all admin surfaces

sections.title: Authentication
items: Added custom M3-styled sign-in page at /sign-in — replaces Clerk's hosted UI with a brand-consistent form using M3 elevation, color tokens, and HeroUI inputs (OAK-51)

Inline forgot-password flow on the sign-in page — multi-step email → verification code → new password, all animated with Framer Motion horizontal slide transitions using M3 emphasized-decelerate easing (OAK-52)
Sign-in page auto-redirects authenticated users to /admin and shows M3Spinner while Clerk SDK initializes (OAK-51)
ClerkProvider now configured with signInUrl="/sign-in" so Clerk's internal redirects (e.g., RedirectToSignIn) point to the custom page (OAK-51)

sections.title: Maintenance
items: Added 9 unit tests for SignInPage in src/test/pages/sign-in.test.tsx — covers field rendering, auth redirect, Clerk error display, successful sign-in, forgot-password panel transitions, reset code submission, and back-navigation (OAK-51, OAK-52)

sections.title: Design System
items: Introduced Material Design 3 (M3) color system — added --md-sys-color-* CSS custom properties for all M3 color roles (primary, secondary, tertiary, surface, outline, background, error) in both light and dark themes (OAK-48)
Added M3 motion tokens to Tailwind — standard, emphasized, and accelerate/decelerate easing curves; short/medium/long duration scale; elevation shadow levels 0–5 (OAK-48)

New M3Spinner component (src/components/m3/spinner.tsx) — SVG circular indeterminate progress with dual CSS animations matching M3 spec; replaces HeroUI Spinner in all Suspense fallbacks and admin pages (OAK-49)
New LinearProgress component (src/components/m3/linear-progress.tsx) — M3 horizontal indeterminate progress bar with two-bar animation pattern (OAK-49)
New BottomSheet component (src/components/m3/bottom-sheet.tsx) — Framer Motion draggable sheet with spring physics, backdrop fade, and drag-to-dismiss at 100px threshold (OAK-49)

sections.title: Navigation
items: Admin-only nav links (Edit Cards, Categories) are now hidden from the public nav — all users see only Home, Changelog, and Usage (OAK-50)
Added auth-gated Admin link in both desktop and mobile nav — visible only when signed in (OAK-50)
Sign In button now navigates to /sign-in route instead of opening a Clerk modal — uses programmatic navigation via useNavigate (OAK-50)

sections.title: Maintenance
items: Added 4 unit tests for M3Spinner — render, aria-label, and size attribute checks (OAK-49)
Added 5 unit tests for Navbar auth-gating — Admin link visibility, removed links, public link presence (OAK-50)

sections.title: Maintenance
items: Added Vitest + React Testing Library test infrastructure — vitest.config.ts, src/test/setup.ts, and test scripts (npm run test, npm run test:run); pre-commit hook now runs the full test suite before every commit (OAK-16)

Added 28 unit tests for useBoosterPackGeneration hook — covers pack card counts, no-duplicate invariants, wildcard selection logic, empty/undersized collection handling, pack history capping, state updates, and analytics call counts (OAK-17)

Added 23 unit tests for utils/categories.ts — covers Firestore data mapping, in-memory cache behavior, empty-Firestore fallback with setDoc seeding, error handling, getDefaultCategories purity, and categoriesToLegacyFormat conversion (OAK-18)

sections.title: Maintenance
items: Added ErrorBoundary component — catches uncaught render errors and lazy-load failures, showing a recovery UI with error details and a reload button instead of a blank screen (OAK-12)
Converted admin page imports (EditPage, EditCardPage, CategoriesPage) to React.lazy() with a Suspense spinner fallback — main bundle reduced from ~1,414 kB to ~1,289 kB (OAK-13)

Extracted pack generation tuning constants (MIN_WILDCARD_ATTEMPTS, RETRY_MULTIPLIER, PACK_HISTORY_LIMIT, MAX_PACKS_PER_EXPORT) into src/constants/generation.ts; replaced all remaining hardcoded "spoonbill" strings with COLLECTION_IDS.SPOONBILL; removed redundant getCollectionName special-case (OAK-14)
Added three-tier logging strategy to generateBoosterPack; Tier-2 pack-level slot failures now also fire exception({ fatal: false }) to surface in GA analytics (OAK-15)
Removed @firebasegen/default-connector file: dependency and deleted dataconnect/ and dataconnect-generated/ scaffold directories — were never used and had zero imports in src/ (OAK-19)
Added Husky v9 + lint-staged pre-commit hook — automatically runs ESLint (auto-fix) on staged .ts/.tsx files and a full tsc --noEmit type-check on every commit (OAK-20)

sections.title: Maintenance
items: Removed duplicate local Card interfaces from edit.tsx and editcard.tsx — both pages now import the canonical Card type from src/types/index.ts (OAK-10)
Added collectionName? to the canonical Card interface in src/types/index.ts to cover the field used by admin pages (OAK-10)
Replaced { [key: string]: any } cardsData state in index.tsx with { [key: string]: Card[] } — completes the any→Card[] migration across the primary data path (OAK-11)

sections.title: Maintenance
items: Added Card interface to src/types/index.ts and typed the full card pipeline — eliminates any[] throughout pack generation and Excel export hooks (OAK-38)
Renamed LegacyCollection to Collection — the 'Legacy' prefix was a holdover that no longer reflected the type's role (OAK-38)
Replaced positional pack[8] wildcard lookup in Excel export with a semantic pack.find() based on collection membership — export no longer breaks if pack slot order changes (OAK-39)
Hardened BASE_COLLECTION_IDS with as const satisfies readonly string[] — TypeScript now errors on any mutation or reorder attempt (OAK-39)
Extracted magic numbers from wildcard retry logic into named constants MIN_WILDCARD_ATTEMPTS and RETRY_MULTIPLIER; fixed stale warning message (OAK-40)
Moved analytics calls out of the private generateBoosterPack function — generation is now a pure operation; a single timing() event fires per batch in generatePacks instead of per pack (OAK-40)
Removed dead ./src/hooks/**/* content path from tailwind.config.js — hooks contain no Tailwind class strings (OAK-40)

sections.title: Maintenance
items: Extracted collection constants (COLLECTION_IDS, BASE_COLLECTION_IDS, COLLECTION_DISPLAY_NAMES, COLLECTION_COLORS) into src/constants/collections.ts — eliminates duplication between index.tsx and collection-badge.tsx (OAK-9)
Extracted pack generation logic into useBoosterPackGeneration hook (src/hooks/use-booster-pack-generation.ts) — separates generation state and logic from page UI orchestration (OAK-7)
Extracted Excel export into useExcelExport hook (src/hooks/use-excel-export.ts) with dynamic xlsx import — defers ~1.6 MB bundle until first export, creating a separate Vite chunk (OAK-8)

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed category cache not being set when Firestore returns an empty collection — the result of the default-category fallback is now cached at the getCategories() level, preventing redundant Firestore calls and potential inconsistency on subsequent loads (OAK-25)

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed stale closure in the Firebase sign-in effect on the Card Management page — list.reload() now always uses the current reload reference via useRef, eliminating a potential stale-data risk (OAK-27)

sections.title: Maintenance
items: Removed unused editcard.tsx component and ui/dialog.tsx wrapper — both had zero imports across the codebase (OAK-31)
Removed orphaned @radix-ui/react-dialog dependency that was only used by the deleted dialog.tsx

sections.title: Bug Fixes & Performance
items: Fixed theme hook crashing in non-browser environments — localStorage is now accessed only after confirming a browser context is available
Fixed unsafe theme value cast that allowed arbitrary strings to be applied as CSS classes on the document root — stored value is now validated before use
Eliminated redundant re-render caused by a self-referential useEffect in the theme provider — each setter now applies DOM changes directly
Stabilized theme context function references with useCallback and useMemo — components that consume the theme context no longer re-render on unrelated updates

sections.title: Admin Form Validation
items: Added input validation to the Edit Card and Categories admin forms — empty names, malformed card numbers, and special-character category IDs are now rejected before reaching Firestore (OAK-30)
Inline error messages appear next to each offending field for clear, immediate feedback
Category ID field is now read-only when editing an existing category to prevent orphaning cards in Firestore

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed broken Sign-In button on the unauthorized page — Clerk's SignInButton now correctly wraps the HeroUI Button so click events are not intercepted by react-aria (OAK-26)
Removed the close (×) button and backdrop-click dismissal from the unauthorized modal — previously left users on a blank white screen with no way to navigate (OAK-32)
Replaced invalid <Link>-inside-<Button> pattern on the Go Back button with programmatic navigation via useNavigate — fixes assistive-technology compatibility and cross-browser click behavior

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed pack generation producing only 6 cards instead of 10 — each base category now always contributes exactly 2 cards (OAK-22)
Fixed Excel export sometimes firing twice or not at all on rapid clicks — export now uses a direct call with a double-click guard (OAK-23)
Fixed wildcard slot crash when no eligible wildcard categories are configured — slot is now skipped gracefully with a warning (OAK-24)

sections.title: Global Design Revamp
items: Complete visual overhaul with a modern, minimalist aesthetic and glassmorphism effects
Redesigned Home, About, Edit Dashboard, Edit Card, and Categories pages
Implemented smooth entrance animations and improved responsive layouts
Added color-coded collection badges for better visual distinction

sections.title: New Features
items: Added Booster Pack History: View the last 10 generated packs in an accordion layout
Restored main table view for current packs while keeping history accessible
Implemented 'Export to Excel' with improved modal interface

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed category duplication bug in database and UI
Resolved issue where cards were duplicated in the Edit Dashboard

sections.title: Updates
items:
Adjusted wildcard generation to limit card sections
- Added a toggle to limit the booster packs that can be put in the wildcard slot

sections.title: Hotfixes
items: Booster generation now always takes the first 8 cards from: Tropical Rainforest, Children's Zoo, California Trail, and African Savanna (in that order)
Data loading ensures these base categories are included even if they are not listed in Firestore categories
Improved resilience when a category is empty by skipping gracefully during selection
Export columns mirror the fixed ordering and display names; corrected display to "African Savanna"

sections.title: Hotfixes
items: Pack generation now uses all active categories for the 9th card (no longer limited to hardcoded categories)
Editing a card now correctly updates its category by moving the document between collections without errors

sections.title: Feature Enhancements
items: Added search functionality to edit page with support for names, numbers, and categories (EB)
Added Active/Inactive switches directly in the cards table for quick view and update (EB)
Added the ability to create, update, and delete card categories (EB)

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Categories now load dynamically from Firebase instead of being hardcoded
Fixed duplicate card issue

sections.title: Minor Changes
items: Added a tooltip to highlight table sorting
Added spinners and loading indicators for better user feedback during operations
Centralized Firebase configuration in `/src/lib/firebase.ts`
Implemented smart caching with invalidation for category data
Reduced Firebase calls through caching and optimized data loading
Enhanced tracking for category management and card toggle actions

sections.title: Feature Enhancements
items: Added detailed usage information to the usage (about) page
Implemented interactive timeline-based Changelog page
Improved information architecture for better user guidance

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed Excel sheet generation issue
Enhanced analytics tracking with Firebase and Google Analytics
Added comprehensive usage metrics collection for page views, card generation, and user interactions

sections.title: Minor Changes
items: Updated contact information with Oakland Zoo emails
Added tooltip explanations for key features

sections.title: Major Website Revamp
items: Complete UI redesign with modern card-based interface
New theme system with light/dark mode support
Responsive layout for better mobile experience
Improved navigation and user accessibility
Enhanced card editing interface for administrators

sections.title: New Features
items: Multi-pack generation (5, 10, 20 packs at once)
Collapsible pack cards for better organization
Card checkoff system to track pack assembly progress
Added Active/Inactive toggle to edit card page
User authentication system for card editors

sections.title: Technical Improvements
items: Framework update to latest version
Performance optimizations for faster load times
Improved code structure and maintainability
Added analytics for usage tracking

sections.title: Initial Release
items: First version of the Oakland Zoo Booster Pack Generator launched with basic functionality for random card generation and simple management interface.
